notes.title: V1.2 is out!
notes.content:
Like Finite State Automaton Challenges 1, we introduced a novel gameplay: Finite State Automaton with Various States and added 20 levels based on this gameplay.

[h1]Automaton with Various States[/h1]

Traditional finite state automata only have three types of states: begin, accept, and normal.

From now on, we will have various state types for different levels. The below picture shows an example.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44772744/1a002070af889b98f747ecf5bd3c8d2eaa23a095.png[/img]
In this example, states 2, 3, and 4 are used to accept "a," "b," and "c," respectively.
